description: This file defines the internal class `SocketConnection` which manages socket-based network connections, handling asynchronous reading and writing, connection lifecycle, and error handling within the Orleans networking infrastructure.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: A sealed internal class that manages a socket-based connection, implementing the TransportConnection interface, providing asynchronous read/write, connection lifecycle control, and error handling.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins processing the socket connection by starting async receive/send loops.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that runs the core receive and send processes and handles cleanup.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Attempts to gracefully shut down the connection in response to an abort reason.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the connection, completing input/output and awaiting ongoing processing.

methods.name: DoReceive
methods.description: Manages the asynchronous receive loop, processing incoming data and handling connection errors.

methods.name: ProcessReceives
methods.description: Performs continuous reads from the socket, writing data into the input pipe until fin or error.

methods.name: DoSend
methods.description: Manages the asynchronous send loop, reading data from the output pipe and sending it through the socket.

methods.name: ProcessSends
methods.description: Performs continuous writes from the output pipe to the socket.

methods.name: FireConnectionClosed
methods.description: Schedules a callback to mark connection as closed and signal waiting tasks.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Closes the socket connection, disposing resources and setting shutdown reasons.

methods.name: CancelConnectionClosedToken
methods.description: Cancels the connection closed token to signal disconnection.

methods.name: IsConnectionResetError
methods.description: Determines if a socket error code indicates a connection reset scenario.

methods.name: IsConnectionAbortError
methods.description: Determines if a socket error code indicates a connection abort scenario.
